deployments_detail.use: Internal generative AI (MS Copilot/AWS) for minutes, agendas, ideation, programming support

Automotive digital cockpit / in-cabin experiences built on Qualcomm's GenAI-powered Snapdragon Cockpit platform, integrated into Alps Alpine's High-Performance Reference Architecture (HPRA); integration underway as of Jan 2025. [Qualcomm (Snapdragon Cockpit, GenAI)]

In-house-developed AI actively applied on production lines for automation of visual inspections via machine vision and AI, part of smart-factory manufacturing quality control. [Alps Alpine (in-house AI)]

Data Solution Service worker-monitoring product with AI-based predictive alerts: models learn each worker's normal vital-sign baselines from time-series data and flag heatstroke risk / anomalies for workers and supervisors; deployed with logistics customers (DHL, Hitachi Kenki Logistics, ALPS LOGISTICS). [Alps Alpine (Data Solution Service)]

Saki 3D SPI (3Si) and 3D AOI (3Di) inspection systems adopted at the Kakuda Plant for solder/board inspection quality; plant aims to further cut false calls to zero by leveraging Saki's AI solutions (AI-specific step stated as objective). [Saki Corporation (3D AOI/SPI with AI)]

Under-display driver monitoring system (DMS) jointly developed with Smart Eye (AI-based eye/face tracking) and AUO, keeping camera hardware hidden while enabling driver monitoring; showcased as a technology demonstration at CES 2026. [Smart Eye, AUO Mobility Solutions]

Digital Cabin automotive cockpit built on Qualcomm 3rd-generation Snapdragon Cockpit Platforms (AI-based compute platforms) delivering electronic mirror, ceiling display, and individual sound zones; targeted for commercial availability in 2024. [Qualcomm (Snapdragon Cockpit, AI-based)]

Company-wide internal generative AI: deployed Azure OpenAI in fall 2023 starting with the Software Technology and Quality Assurance departments, used for meeting minutes, brainstorming, and coding support; non-software engineers built inspection-management tools with it. [Microsoft (Azure OpenAI)]

Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat rolled out company-wide to Japanese employees, plus a Microsoft 365 Copilot pilot in meeting-heavy administrative divisions; internal AI-usage guidelines and a 2025 internal AI-use-case competition were established to drive adoption. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: ~7 hours saved per employee per month (admin divisions pilot)

deployments_detail.use: AI-based demand-forecasting models built for global supply-chain production planning to reduce inventory and opportunity losses, with plans to expand coverage across device products. [ABeam Consulting]

AI optical character recognition (AI-OCR) combining deep-learning and image-processing technology used in manufacturing/software processes for document and data digitalization. [Alps Alpine (in-house, deep learning)]
